arguments.question: Can we buy food contact items or gaskets from a supplier without a food-grade certificate?

content: No. Under Rasoi's Purchase Policy (POL-PUR-001 §6.2) and Supplier Policy (POL-SUP-003 §4.1), parts that come into contact with food—including gaskets—may only be purchased from a supplier holding a valid food-grade certificate on file in Bahi. Even if their price is better, no order can be placed with them until a valid food-grade certificate is uploaded and verified.
